g.text: Taps CON1 of the console switch panel PCB IP-678A

g.text: BTN = CON1-5 (Parking Safety switch line), 12.2 V idle in the car

g.text: 1. BTN = CON1-5, Parking Safety switch (~200R to GND in the panel), 12.2 V idle. Q1 + R3 emulate a press.

g.desc: 1. BTN = CON1-5, Parking Safety switch (~200R to GND in the panel), 12.2 V idle. Q1 + R3 emulate a press.

g.text: 2. CAN is silent by default: R6 holds SLNT high and firmware keeps it high (listen-only). Set the CAN Pal termination switch OFF.

g.desc: 2. CAN is silent by default: R6 holds SLNT high and firmware keeps it high (listen-only). Set the CAN Pal termination switch OFF.

g.text: 3. GPIO2/8/9 are strapping pins (GPIO8 = LED): leave unconnected.

g.desc: 3. GPIO2/8/9 are strapping pins (GPIO8 = LED): leave unconnected.
